NOTIFICATION NO: 14/MRB/2025 DATE: 28.10.2025
CORRIGENDUM
In partial modification of the Notification No.14/MRB/2025 dated:
09.09.2025 for the post of Assistant Medical Officer (Siddha),
(i) The para No.8 “CENTRE FOR EXAMINATION" is changed as detailed
below.
8. CENTRE FOR EXAMINATION
Examination will be conducted in the following 9 (Nine) Districts.
S.No District Names
1 Chennai
2 Chengalpattu
3 Coimbatore
4 Kancheepuram
5 Madurai
6 Salem
7 Trichy
8 Thiruvallur
9 Virudhunagar
Note:
The Board reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of
Examination Centres depending on administrative exigencies.
MEMBER SECRETARY
